title: 公園管理用のスコップ
description: 花壇・公園管理小屋に置く手作業用スコップ。浅く湾曲した厚みのある刃、足掛けの折返しとリブ、金属ソケット、木色の柄、開いたD字握りを造形。刃先を下にした展示姿勢で、壁や道具掛けへの配置は利用者側で調整してください。土や掘削動作は含みません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.217 × 1.043 × 0.059 m、3,156三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A hand spade for flower-bed and park-maintenance scenes, with a shallow dished solid blade, folded foot treads and ribs, metal socket, plain wood-colored shaft and open D grip. Presented blade-down; adjust support and placement against a wall or tool rack in the host scene. Soil and digging behavior are absent. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.217 × 1.043 × 0.059 m; 3,156 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
